purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0024 after the existing sample was blocked or revised by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出 field testing 能开始的硬条件。
front.task_prompt: provided 后面给成立门槛；主句 can start field testing 只是结果蓝图。

task_schema.action: 选择 provided 引出的成立条件
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分主句行动计划是结果，provided 后的审批状态才是硬条件

options.text: The safety approval comes through tonight.
The team starts field testing this morning.
The team cancels the safety approval process.
The field testing has already finished.

audio.transcript: The team can start field testing next week, provided the safety approval comes through tonight.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。The team can start field testing next week 是结果设想，provided 后面的 the safety approval comes through tonight 才是这个结果成立的硬条件。条件关系题里不要把主句里的计划当成前提；听到 provided/as long as/on condition that 时，要把注意力移到条件从句。B 把结果时间听错，C、D 都与原句不符。
tips: provided 后通常是“只有满足它，主句才成立”的门槛。
先把主句结果和条件从句分开，再回答必要前提。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 provided 引出的硬条件

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在条件句中先抓成立门槛，避免把主句计划误当作条件。

front.text: 听完后，选出 statewide expansion 的必要前提。
front.task_prompt: if 从句给前提，主句给结果；题目问前提时回到 if 后的内容。

task_schema.action: 选择 if 从句里的成立前提
task_schema.focus: if 条件与主句扩展结果
task_schema.success_criteria: 能说明 if 从句里的数据状态是前提，主句里的扩展计划是结果

options.text: The pilot data stay stable for another month.
All local offices reopen this week.

audio.transcript: If the pilot data remain stable for another month, the agency will expand the program statewide.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。If the pilot data remain stable for another month 是条件从句，the agency will expand the program statewide 是条件满足后的结果。题目问计划扩大的必要前提时，应选 if 从句里的 data stability，而不是主句里的 expansion。A、C、D 都没有出现在音频中，也不是这句话设定的条件。
tips: if 在句首时，先等主句出现，再把“前提 -> 结果”配对。
题干问前提/条件，就不要选主句结果。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 if 从句里的计划成立前提

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把 if 条件和主句结果稳定配对，减少把结果误选为前提的错误。

front.text: 听到 unless 后，选出 registration 保持 offline 的条件。
front.task_prompt: unless 等于 if not；先把反向条件翻正，再判断后果什么时候发生。

task_schema.action: 选择 unless 的反向条件结果
task_schema.focus: unless = if not 的条件转换
task_schema.success_criteria: 能说明 unless 条件未满足时，后续服务状态会保持受限

options.text: The backup server is restored before noon.
The backup server is not restored by noon.
Registration moves fully online before noon.
The backup server is replaced next week.

audio.transcript: Unless the backup server is restored by noon, registration will stay offline for the rest of the day.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。Unless the backup server is restored by noon 等于 if the backup server is not restored by noon；在这个条件下，registration will stay offline for the rest of the day。unless 题最容易错在把条件方向看反：A 是避免 offline 的条件，不是 offline 发生的条件；C、D 没有依据。
tips: 遇到 unless，先改写成 if not。
问后果何时发生时，要选“条件未满足”的那一项。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 unless 的反向条件逻辑

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户把 unless 快速转成 if not，避免在条件未满足与结果发生之间倒置。
